patch_description: Combines the two strongest prior ideas and adds the recommended corner-anchored seeding. Four large circles are placed near the corners (exploiting three-sided wall slack), with a staggered hex-like interior filling the middle. Radii are computed by an exact linear program (as in the 2.44-scoring program) rather than water-filling, and centers are refined by a deterministic constraint-repulsion hill-climb (as in the 2.45 program), re-solving the LP each round. Multiple structured seeds are tried and the best is returned, improving robustness without relying on a single fragile layout.
